items.title: Packers vs. Rams Start 'Em, Sit 'Em: Wednesday Night - Jordan Love, Christian Watson, Matthew Golden, Tucker Kraft, Matthew Stafford, Kyren Williams, Blake Corum, Tyler Higbee, more
Colts signed QB Shane Buechele off the Bills’ practice squad.
items.text: Buechele got his first NFL experience last year in Week 18, at age 27, when he completed 7-of-14 passes for 88 yards in a game the Chiefs were (probably) looking to lose against the Raiders. He was sacked five times. These last six Colts games will feel like they take five months. - Rivers McCown

items.title: Ravens waived WR LaJohntay Wester.
items.text: Wester muffed two punts last week against the Panthers, which we’re told is “not a good way to keep your roster spot” when you are here to be the returner. The Ravens will shuffle the deck here. - Rivers McCown

items.title: Packers activated Micah Parsons (knee/PUP) off the physically unable to perform list.
items.text: In other words, the questionable listing from an hour ago does not actually matter. Parsons is back after losing almost a year to a torn ACL. He’ll be directed to put some havoc on the field in his return against the Rams on Wednesday night. - Rivers McCown

items.title: Steve Avila (hamstring) will not play in Los Angeles’ Week 12 game against the Packers.
items.text: Avila did not play in Week 10 and did not practice at all this week coming out of a Week 11 bye. Perhaps the extra rest after this one will get him to a workable place in Week 13. Beaux Limmer started at guard in his place against the Cardinals in Week 10, but with Coleman Shelton (hamstring) also ruled out at center it’s possible that Limmer starts there instead. Bill Murray is the only other interior lineman on the 53-man roster currently, and it’s going to be almost Thanksgiving, not Groundhog Day. - Rivers McCown

items.title: Colby Parkinson (ribs) is not on Los Angeles’ final Week 11 injury report.
items.text: He and Tyler Higbee will both be featured parts of this offense as the Rams look to get by without Puka Nacua. The one that catches a touchdown will be the one that you don’t start. - Rivers McCown

items.title: Kyren Williams (toe) is not on Los Angeles’ final Week 12 injury report.
items.text: He’ll be good to go against the Packers on Wednesday night. Williams should figure into the high RB2 mix as the Rams try to replace Puka Nacua once again with plenty of split back formations. - Rivers McCown

items.title: Colts signed OL Wanya Morris off the Cowboys’ practice squad.
items.text: Jalen Travis and Bernhard Raimann are both dealing with injuries, and other names on the Colts 53-man roster at tackle include Luke Tenuta, Charlie Heck, and Matt Goncalves (a guard last year) as they try to see out the end of this disastrous season. Morris will attempt to see it with them. - Rivers McCown

items.title: Micah Parsons (knee) is questionable for Green Bay’s Week 12 game against the Rams.
items.text: We have no doubts he’ll play — Rams EDGE Myles Garrett said he was able to give Parsons some tickets for the 27-year-old’s long-awaited return yesterday. But players returning from PUP and IR have frequently just gotten a questionable tag regardless of how likely they are to play. Parsons got in limited work in each of the three practices this week. - Rivers McCown

items.title: Josh Jacobs (thumb) is questionable for Green Bay’s Week 11 game against the Rams.
items.text: He got in limited work in each of Green Bay’s three practices this week, though some of them were “estimated” given the short week. Matt LaFleur said he was unlikely to play on Monday, so perhaps this is just a gamesmanship questionable. Obviously, if Jacobs does play, he’d be a suitable low-end RB2. - Rivers McCown

items.title: Ravens waived QB Kedon Slovis.
items.text: He’ll reportedly garner interest from the Arizona Cardinals for some reason. Slovis, 25, played for Arizona in the preseason and the Texans in the 2025 preseason. Over his three preseason stints he’s 86-of-126 for 816 yards, three touchdowns, and three interceptions while taking nine sacks. - Rivers McCown
